subject: general
question: Which Indian airport has become the first in the country to achieve “water-positive” status?

options.text: Netaji Subhash Chandra Bose International Airport

solution:
The correct answer is __**Indira Gandhi International Airport.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__** 

__
 
• **Indira Gandhi International Airport (IGIA) has become India's first airport to achieve “water-positive” status, with a capacity of more than 40 million passengers per annum.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__** 

__
 
• **IGIA achieved the distinction of becoming the first Indian airport to generate more water than it consumes.**
 
• **The achievement aligns with the airport’s long-term vision of becoming a net-zero airport.**
 
• **The effort reflects responsible resource usage, enhanced resilience, and climate readiness.**
 
• **The initiative is led by Delhi International Airport Limited (DIAL), headed by CEO Videh Kumar Jaipuriar.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

__
 
• **Indira Gandhi International Airport (IGIA)**__

 __
 
• IATA Code – DEL; ICAO Code – VIDP
 
• Located in Palam, Delhi; spread across 5,106 acres
 
• Busiest airport in India in both passenger and cargo traffic
 
• Ninth-busiest airport globally (2025) as per OAG rankings
 
 
 
• **Kempegowda International Airport**__
 __
 
• Located in Bengaluru
 
• Known for Terminal 2, India’s first “garden terminal”
 
 
 
• **Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj International Airport**__
 __
 
• Located in Mumbai
 
• India’s second busiest airport by passenger traffic
 
 
 
• **Rajiv Gandhi International Airport**__
 
 
• Located in Hyderabad
 
• Operated by GMR Hyderabad International Airport Ltd.
